Container.Name: supertermai
Container.Overview: Always-on SSH shell for running Claude Code and other coding agents inside a persistent herdr or tmux session, with an optional VS Code Remote Tunnel. Detach, reconnect from any device, and pick up where you left off. Ubuntu 24.04, key-only SSH, unprivileged, no host mounts beyond appdata.

Config.Name: SSH Port
Config.Description: Host port for SSH into the container.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Home directory of the SSH user: shell history, ~/.claude, herdr/tmux config, VS Code tunnel login.

Config.Name: Public Key
Config.Description: SSH public key allowed to log in (contents of your .pub file). Password login is disabled.

Config.Name: VS Code Tunnel
Config.Description: true to run a VS Code Remote Tunnel in the background. First time: SSH in and run `code tunnel user login --provider github` once.

Config.Name: Tunnel Name
Config.Description: Name shown in VS Code's Remote Explorer and at vscode.dev/tunnel/<name>.

Config.Name: SSH CA Public Key
Config.Description: Optional. Public key of an SSH certificate authority to trust (e.g. Cloudflare Access short-lived certificates for a browser-rendered terminal).

Config.Name: SSH CA Principals
Config.Description: Optional, with SSH CA Public Key. Comma-separated certificate principals; each becomes an alias of the SSH user (same uid and home). Cloudflare logs in as your email prefix, e.g. jdoe for jdoe@example.com.

Config.Name: Sudo Access
Config.Description: true to give the SSH user passwordless sudo inside the container.
